changelog: - **Zone names and the selected node's name stay readable when zoomed out.** Where the canvas text becomes too small to read, each zone's name is shown at a readable size on its zone's top border, and the name of the one selected node beside it; with several nodes selected, no name is shown. The names take no clicks and keep their places while you pan, zoom or drag; the selected name is hidden while a drag would have it cover something, and at the canvas edge it slides inward or is hidden, never cut. When a document opens, a name appears once, at its final place. Keyboard focus on a zone, or on its name chip, is marked on the name you read: dashed for the zone, solid for the chip.
